product_metadata.title: LILIAO Playing Cat Cookie Cutter - 4.6 x 3.6 inches - Stainless Steel
features: Cat lovers will like this 4.6 inches large playing cat cookie cutter.
Made from Food Safe Stainless Steel.
Not only perfect for cutting cookie dough, but also for cutting fondant, bread, sandwiches, jelly, cheese, soft fruits, pancake, soap, craft clay.
Smooth cutter edge makes them easy to use for adults and kids, the other side for press is binding processed, makes them safety to use.
Stainless steel material, not easy to get rust, very durable and dishwasher safe.
